info.title: Ordinon Public API
info.description: The Ordinon external API for integrating with the document platform.

get.description: Get the organization associated with the API key.
Get the organization with document and member counts.
List active and pending members of the organization.

Public endpoint for the www site. Returns only publicly visible published versions.
No authentication required — filters to is_public == True only.
List all documents in the organization.
List all tags in the organization.

schema.title: Response Ext List Tags V1 Documents Tags Get
Response Ext List Topics V1 Documents Topics Get

get.description: Get a single document with tags, topics, and version labels.

patch.description: Update a document's metadata, tags, or topics.

post.description: Publish a new version of a document from its current sections.

get.description: List all top-level sections (with nested sub_sections) for a document. Content is omitted for brevity.

schema.title: Response Ext List Sections V1 Documents  Document Id  Sections Get

post.description: Create a new section in a document.

get.description: Get a single section by ID, including its content and sub_sections.

patch.description: Update a section. Bypasses collaborative locks (not relevant for API usage).

delete.description: Delete a section. Bypasses collaborative locks.

patch.description: Reorder sections within a document (or within a parent section).

get.description: List all versions of a document with pagination.
List version labels (id + label) for a document.

schema.title: Response Ext List Version Labels V1 Documents  Document Id  Versions Labels Get

get.description: Get a single version by ID, including its snapshot data.

patch.description: Update a version's metadata, visibility, or access grants.

delete.description: Delete a version. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: List all API keys for the organization.

post.description: Create a new API key. The raw key is only returned once during creation.

Create a file record and return a SAS URL for direct upload to Azure.
The client should PUT the file content to the returned URI, then call /verify.
Mark a file as uploaded after the client has finished uploading to the SAS URL.

get.description: Get a temporary SAS read URL for a file.
Stream the file content directly (proxied from Azure).

delete.description: Delete a file from storage and the database.
